name: fse-std
title: FSE std (library)
author: mtopfox
description: A GUI library for other mods: movable, resizable windows that remember where they were, and drag & drop between GUI elements. Drag & drop and resizing need the fse loader's std plugin (mouse buttons and position); without it windows still move and drag & drop works by click-to-pick, click-to-drop. Themes: 12 looks for every mod's windows that use them (/fse-theme), with colours edited live through the fse loader.
